config.hypothesis: A small spatial CNN can learn local weave discontinuities without excessive capacity

initial_ann.hypothesis: A small spatial CNN can learn local weave discontinuities without excessive capacity
initial_ann.determinism: Fixed seeds; deterministic algorithms requested with warnings for unsupported kernels
initial_ann.outcome: Measured validation evidence; no test-driven changes
initial_ann.lesson: Validation F2=0.0923, AP=0.0188, TP/FP/FN=41/1973/11. Difference from initial ANN F2=+0.0000; best epoch 1 of 4. Recorded mean training loss 1.2777 to 1.2564. Assess learning rate and convergence within the recorded budget; a short-run difference does not establish eventual learnability. Train/validation prevalence differs, so a raw loss gap alone does not diagnose overfitting.

final_ann.lesson: Validation F2=0.4856, AP=0.4991, TP/FP/FN=27/43/25. Difference from initial ANN F2=+0.3934; best epoch 2 of 4. Recorded mean training loss 0.9116 to 0.2142. Real ImageNet transfer is tested with all layers fine-tuned, replicated grayscale and no crop. Domain mismatch and this early-training budget limit the conclusion. classical.hypothesis: Local texture histograms may be competitive when independent source coverage is limited
classical.timing_note: Feature extraction is charged on first use; later configurations reuse features
classical.outcome: Measured validation evidence; no test-driven changes
classical.lesson: Validation F2=0.1646, AP=0.0965, TP/FP/FN=8/27/44. Matched counterpart svm-search-030 differs in features (lbp -> hog_lbp): F2 difference +0.0933, AP difference +0.0824. These descriptive differences do not establish a universal setting effect. hog_lbp with SVC, kernel=rbf, C=0.1, class_weight=None. Descriptor extraction and scaling use train only; the score cutoff uses validation. Interpret kernel/weighting with matched feature/C controls. Only one validation origin is represented, so these are descriptive selection results.

serving_bundle.selection_policy: Validation F2, then average precision, then smaller parameter count

seed_repeat_protocol.rule: Repeat selected configuration on train/val before freeze; report spread and record whether variation is material

calibration.limitation: Validation reliability/calibration estimates share selection data; do not establish guaranteed confidence

config.prompt: Classify this fabric patch. Look for a local disruption, hole, stain or anomalous yarn rather than ordinary repeating weave or lighting. Reply with only one label: defective or defect_free.
config.parsing_policy: Exact defective/defect_free token or one canonical sentence: The/This fabric (patch) is defective/defect-free. Any extra reasoning or ambiguity is unresolved.
config.failure_policy: Unresolved (-1) counts as an error for its true class; retain every example
config.image_processor: Publisher AutoProcessor at the same immutable revision
config.image_size_note: Underlying 256x256 pixels preserved; no splitting or upscaling. 16 visual tokens = (256/16 patch size)^2 / 4^2 pixel-shuffle factor. Processor token count explicitly matches vision output.
config.compute_cost: Hardware, electricity and CPU time; not measured as money

protocol.vlm_unresolved: Count as error, retain all examples
protocol.timing: Batch size 1, three warmup examples; end-to-end decode/preprocess included
protocol.xai: Grad-CAM defect logit, fixed 10% top/low/random mean-fill occlusion
